# Unity Command — Skill Tree

Capabilities mapped by domain. Each capability lists the modules involved, the user-visible surface (Discord command / natural-language trigger / API call), and the persistence story.

Status legend:
- ✅ **Implemented + active**
- ⚠️ **Partial / depends on external service**
- 🧪 **Stub or experimental** — code present but not fully wired


> **⚠ REMOVED 2026-05-19** — The collab subsystem (claudecolab + Supabase shared brain + cross-Claude G/R task queue + `.claude/collab/` Python modules + `/brain/*` Flask endpoints) was deleted wholesale per operator directive. V4 is single-instance only. References below are retained as historical context but the features no longer exist.


---

## 1. Conversation

### 1.1 Natural chat (Pollinations.ai backend) — ✅
- **Modules**: `message_handler.py`, `api_client.py`, `memory_manager.py`, `config.py`
- **Surface**: any non-command message in an allowed channel (or DM)
- **Model**: per-user-per-guild via `!setmodel`, defaults to `"unity"`
- **System prompt**: `system_instructions.txt` + `\nYou are <model>.`
- **Context window**: last 20 user/AI turns scoped per-user-per-model + 5 channel memories
- **Response sizing**: three tiers — `≤2000` plain, `≤4096` embed, `>4096` `.txt` attachment

### 1.2 Code-block extraction — ✅
- **Trigger**: user message contains `"code"` or `"script"`
- **Parser**: regex `\[CODE\]\s*(\w+)\s*([\s\S]*?)\[/CODE\]`
- **Behavior**: each block sent as its own message (plain ≤2000 / embed ≤4096 / `.txt` >4096) wrapped in triple-backtick fences with the captured language
- **Source**: `MessageHandler._send_message`

### 1.3 Inline image attachment — ✅
- **Trigger**: AI response contains URLs matching `https?://\S+`
- **Behavior**: URLs are extracted, downloaded via `aiohttp.ClientSession`, attached as `discord.File` named `image.png`
- **Notes**: failed fetches are logged but don't block the text message; only one filename used regardless of count

### 1.4 Response cleaning — ✅
- **Source**: `MessageHandler.clean_response`
- **Strips**: model-name prefixes (`[claude]`, `[revclaude]`, `[gpt]`, `[openai]`, `[assistant]`), `---` separators, lines containing `"Generated by"` or `\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}`
- **Normalizes**: collapses 3+ consecutive newlines to 2

---

## 2. Memory

### 2.1 Rolling conversation history — ✅
- **Storage**: in-RAM via `MemoryManager`, persisted to `logs/chat_data.json` via `DataManager.save_data_async`
- **Three parallel ledgers**:
  - `channel_histories[channel_id]` — channel-wide (cap 20)
  - `user_histories[guild_id][user_id]` — per-user-per-guild (cap 20)
  - `user_model_histories[guild_id][user_id][model_name]` — per-user-per-model (cap 20, **RAM only — not persisted**)
- **Note**: `MessageHandler` reads from the per-user-per-model history when building the Pollinations request

### 2.2 Channel memories (pinned notes) — ✅
- **Command**: `!savememory <text>`
- **Surface**: `commands.py` `savememory`
- **Storage**: `MemoryManager.channel_memories[channel_id]`, cap 5, dedupe-on-add
- **Use**: prepended as a synthetic user message before the rolling history when calling Pollinations
- **Persistence**: written to `logs/chat_data.json`

### 2.3 Memory wipe — ✅
- **Command**: `!wipe`
- **Source**: `bot.py` `wipe` command
- **Scope**: clears `channel_histories[channel_id]`, `user_histories[guild_id][user_id]`, and every `user_model_histories[guild_id][user_id][*]` for the invoking user in the invoking guild — channel memories are NOT cleared

### 2.4 Channel notes via system-instructions regex — 🧪
- **Trigger**: AI response containing `$$ memory $$...$$ /memory $$` (regex defined in `config.memory_regex`)
- **Status**: regex compiled in `config.py` but no current code branch references it — likely vestigial / planned hook

---

## 3. Model management

### 3.1 Model discovery — ✅
- **Source**: `api_client.fetch_models()` calls `GET text.pollinations.ai/models`
- **Fallback**: `[{"name": "unity", "description": "Default unity model"}]` if API unreachable
- **Cached**: in `MemoryManager.models`, refreshed only on startup

### 3.2 Per-user model selection — ✅
- **Command**: `!setmodel` (DMs the user a chunked button UI)
- **UI**: `commands.ModelSelectView` — `discord.ui.View` with `ButtonStyle.grey` buttons, 25 per view, paginated
- **Storage**: `MemoryManager.user_models[guild_id][user_id]` → `logs/chat_data.json`
- **Defaults**: new user gets `"unity"` model, logged on first lookup
- **Scope**: per-guild — same user in different guilds can have different models

### 3.3 Help / model listing — ✅
- **Command**: `!unityhelp`
- **Embed**: lists `!unityhelp / !setmodel / !savememory / !wipe` + all available models with descriptions

---

## 4. Discord integration

### 4.1 Channel allowlist — ✅
- **Env**: `ALLOWED_CHANNELS=<id1>,<id2>,...`
- **Behavior**: if set, ignore messages from any guild channel whose ID isn't listed; DMs always pass
- **Source**: `bot.py` on_message + `config.allowed_channels`

### 4.2 Startup greeting — ✅
- **Trigger**: `on_ready` event
- **Behavior**: scan `CLAUDE_CHAT_CHANNEL_ID` for other bots; if any present, call Pollinations with context `"You just came online. Other bots: X. Introduce yourself."` and send the generated greeting + tagged mentions
- **Fallback**: if no other bots present, send plain `"Hey everyone! Gee's Unity is now online and ready to chat!"`

### 4.3 Bot-to-bot interaction — ✅
- **Behavior**: if message author is a bot, delay 10 s before responding (etiquette / loop-avoidance)
- **Identity hints**: `system_instructions.txt` explicitly tells the model it's aware of other bots and can use `<@USER_ID>` mentions

### 4.4 Member intents — ✅
- **Required intents**: `default()` + `message_content=True` + `members=True`
- **`members=True`** needed so `channel.members` returns full member list (including bot members) in `detect_channel_bots()`

---

## 5. Image generation — ⚠️ (delegated)

V4 does **not** generate images itself. The Pollinations.ai backend handles generation — the bot just passes user prompts through with the system instructions guiding the model to emit `https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/...` URLs.

- **System-instruction URL template**: `https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/<text>?height=512&width=512&seed={seed}&private=true&safe=false&enhanced=true&model=turbo&nologo=true`
- **Detection**: `config.image_keywords` (`image, picture, photo, generate, create, draw, art`) — present-but-currently-unused helper
- **Display**: URLs in the model response are downloaded by `MessageHandler` and attached as files (see 1.3)

---

## 6. Claude-to-Claude bridge (Flask REST on :5050)

### 6.1 Status endpoint — ✅
- `GET /claude/status` → `{status, bot_connected, channel_id, messages_stored, message_count, timestamp}`

### 6.2 Message reading — ✅
- `GET /claude/read?limit=N&since=ISO` — reads from in-memory ring (cap 100 messages)
- `GET /claude/history` — full ring dump
- `POST /claude/clear` — drop the ring

### 6.3 Message posting as Unity — ✅
- `POST /claude/post {message, prefix?}` — sends to `CLAUDE_CHAT_CHANNEL_ID`
- Bridges threading boundary via `asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(coro, bot.loop)` with 10s timeout

### 6.4 CLI request marking — ✅
- **Triggers** (in `bot.py`): `!cli`, `hey cli`, `claude cli`, `real claude`, `actual claude`, `!realunity`
- **Behavior**: prepends `[CLI_REQUEST]` to recorded message, reacts 🤖, **skips auto-response** so the CLI can answer instead

### 6.5 MCP stdio server — ✅
- **File**: `unity_mcp_server.py` (separate process, JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout)
- **Tools exposed**: `unity_status`, `unity_read`, `unity_post`, `unity_check`
- **Backend**: all four tools call the local Flask API on `:5050`
- **`unity_check`** filters by trigger keywords (`claude, cli, hey unity, unity?, @unity, real claude, actual claude`) and skips messages where `from_claude == "unity"` (no self-loop)

See [API.md](API.md) for endpoint payloads and request/response shapes.

## 8. Operations

### 8.1 Self-update via git — ✅
- **Period**: 15 min
- **Mechanism**: `git remote update` + `git status -uno` → if `b"behind"` in stdout, exec `linux/update.sh` (POSIX) or `windows\update.bat` (Windows)
- **Update scripts**:
  - `linux/update.sh` — stops `unitybot` systemd service if installed, moves `.env` to `$HOME`, `git fetch && git pull`, `pip install -r requirements.txt`, restores `.env`, restarts service
  - `windows\update.bat` — kills `python.exe` running `bot.py` via `tasklist`/`taskkill`, moves `.env` to Desktop, `git fetch && git pull`, `pip install -r requirements.txt`, restores `.env`, re-launches `python bot.py`

### 8.2 Log rotation — ✅
- **Period**: 1 h
- **Mechanism**: `aiofiles.open("logs/application.log", "w")` + write empty string
- **Trade-off**: keeps logs minimal but **loses history** older than ~1 h. Use external log shipping (`journalctl` if running under systemd, or a logrotate config) if persistent logs needed.

### 8.3 Systemd service — ✅
- **File**: `linux/install.sh` writes `/etc/systemd/system/unitybot.service`
- **Identity**: `User=$SUDO_USER` (or invoking user) so the service runs as the real user, not root
- **Restart policy**: `Restart=on-failure`
- **Env source**: `EnvironmentFile=-/path/to/.env` + `/etc/environment`
- **Python**: uses `.venv/bin/python` — `linux/setup.sh` must run first

### 8.4 Windows native launch — ✅
- **File**: `windows\RUN_BOT.bat`
- **Checks**: Python 3.8-3.11 via `python --version | findstr`, `pip install -r requirements.txt --quiet`, then `python bot.py`
- **No venv**: runs against system Python — `windows\setup.bat` creates `.venv` separately if user opts in

See [DEPLOYMENT.md](DEPLOYMENT.md) for the full setup + run + update walkthrough on each platform.

## 9. Capability matrix

| Capability | User-visible surface | Module | Persistence | Status |
|------------|----------------------|--------|-------------|--------|
| Natural chat | any message | `message_handler.py` | `chat_data.json` | ✅ |
| Code blocks | message contains "code"/"script" | `message_handler.py` | — | ✅ |
| Inline images | URL in AI response | `message_handler.py` | — | ✅ |
| Pinned channel memory | `!savememory <text>` | `commands.py` | `chat_data.json` | ✅ |
| Wipe history | `!wipe` | `bot.py` | `chat_data.json` | ✅ |
| Model selection | `!setmodel` (DM UI) | `commands.py` | `chat_data.json` | ✅ |
| Help | `!unityhelp` | `commands.py` | — | ✅ |
| Channel allowlist | `ALLOWED_CHANNELS` env | `config.py` + `bot.py` | env-only | ✅ |
| Startup greeting | auto on `on_ready` | `bot.py` | — | ✅ |
| Bot-detection | scan channel members | `bot.py` | — | ✅ |
| Image gen | model emits Pollinations URL | (Pollinations) | — | ⚠️ |
| Claude API status | `GET /claude/status` | `claude_api.py` | RAM ring | ✅ |
| Claude API read | `GET /claude/read` | `claude_api.py` | RAM ring | ✅ |
| Claude API post | `POST /claude/post` | `claude_api.py` | RAM ring + Discord | ✅ |
| CLI bridge | `!cli` / trigger phrases | `bot.py` | RAM ring | ✅ |
| MCP server | `unity_mcp_server.py` stdio | separate process | — | ✅ |
| Shared brain | `from collab import brain` | `.claude/collab/shared_brain.py` | Supabase cloud | ✅ |
| Shared tasks | `from collab import tasks` | `.claude/collab/shared_tasks.py` | Supabase cloud | ✅ |
| Brain proxy | `GET /brain/*` | `claude_api.py` | Supabase cloud | ✅ |
| Collab key client | `from collab import collab` | `.claude/collab/claude_collab.py` | Supabase cloud (team-scoped) | 🧪 |
| Task handlers | `task_handlers.py` + Ollama | local Ollama | — | ⚠️ |
| Auto-update | every 15 min | `bot.py` + `update.{sh,bat}` | git | ✅ |
| Log rotation | every 1 h | `bot.py` | `logs/application.log` | ✅ |
| Systemd service | `linux/install.sh` | systemd | OS-level | ✅ |
| Windows launch | `windows\RUN_BOT.bat` | shell script | OS-level | ✅ |
